WITH account_stats AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
account_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(transaction_count) AS avg_transaction_count
    FROM account_stats
)
SELECT account_stats.account_id,
       account_stats.avg_amount,
       account_stats.transaction_count,
       account_stats.transaction_count / account_average.avg_transaction_count AS ratio
FROM account_stats
CROSS JOIN account_average
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
